notes.title: CRM – Overdue loan segmentation query
notes.code:
SELECT customer_id,
       loan_id,
       DATEDIFF(day, due_date, GETDATE()) AS days_overdue,
       outstanding_balance
FROM   loan_accounts
WHERE  status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND  DATEDIFF(day, due_date, GETDATE()) > 30
ORDER  BY days_overdue DESC;
notes.body: Use this to pull customers with DPD > 30 for the monthly NPL report. Pair with the MOB bucket logic.

notes.title: MOB bucket classification
notes.code:
SELECT customer_id,
       CASE
         WHEN mob BETWEEN 1  AND 3  THEN 'Early'
         WHEN mob BETWEEN 4  AND 6  THEN 'Mid'
         WHEN mob BETWEEN 7  AND 12 THEN 'Mature'
         ELSE 'Aged'
       END AS mob_bucket
FROM   customer_mob;
notes.body: MOB = Month on Book. Used in Last MOB campaign targeting.

notes.title: Sprint ticket escalation SOP
notes.body:
1. Identify blocker tickets (status = Blocked > 2 days).
2. Ping assignee on Teams with ticket link.
3. If no response within 4h, escalate to team lead.
4. Log escalation in TicketTracker sheet with timestamp.
5. Follow up next standup.

notes.title: DuPont decomposition – bank ROE
notes.body:
ROE = Net Profit Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier

ROE = (Net Income / Revenue) × (Revenue / Total Assets) × (Total Assets / Equity)

For Vietnamese banks:
- NIM drives NP margin
- Leverage (equity multiplier) is typically high (10–15x)
- Asset quality affects the margin leg (via credit loss provisions)

Apply CAMEL alongside to contextualise each component.

notes.title: CAMEL framework – VN banks
notes.body:
C – Capital Adequacy: CAR (Basel II/III compliance, SBV minimum 8%)
A – Asset Quality: NPL ratio, special-mention loans, LLR coverage
M – Management: governance scores, board independence (VCGS)
E – Earnings: ROA, ROE, NIM, CIR (Cost-to-Income)
L – Liquidity: LDR, short-term funding gap, SBV repo access

Note: SCB collapse (2022) is a canonical case of failure across A, M, L, H simultaneously.

notes.title: Day Past Due
notes.body:
Trong bảng FT_LOAN, 1 KH ~ n Loan, mỗi Loan-Contract có các fields như sau:
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_CURRENT: current DPD for current contract; có thể bằng NULL khi KH hiện tại đã thanh toán, k nợ quá hạn nữa
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_MAX: max DPD từng ghi nhận trên loan-contract này; chỉ bằng 0 khi KH chưa từng nợ quá hạn
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_SUM: sum của DPD từng ghi nhận trên loan-contract này; chỉ bằng 0 khi KH chưa từng nợ quá hạn

Từ các field trên, các field  trong bảng FT_CLIENT_PART_STATIC tức level client (có thể) được aggregate như sau:
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOLERANCE: Max của field CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_CURRENT của các contract cùng 1 KH (trạng thái active hay paidoff/writen off/close gì thì vẫn tính)
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOL_CUR_MAX: Max của field CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_MAX của các ACTIVE contract cùng 1 KH; bằng 0 khi KH hiện không có active contract
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOL_MAX: Max của field CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_MAX của all contract cùng 1 KH
- CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOL_SUM: Sum của field CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_SUM của các contract cùng 1 KH

notes.title: Get client latest contract active
notes.body: find the latest contract (active, HCVN) per client
notes.code:
PROC SQL;
create table get_client_contract_active as
select  t1.ID_CUID
	, t1.CODE_CREDIT_TYPE
	, t1.CODE_PRODUCT
	, t1.CODE_CREDIT_STATUS	
	, t1.SKP_CREDIT_CASE
	, t1.TEXT_CONTRACT_NUMBER
	, t1.DATE_CONTRACT_SIGNATURE
	, t1.CODE_CREDIT_OWNER
	, t1.NAME_DISBURSMENT_CHANNEL_TYPE
	, intck('day', datepart(t1.DATE_CONTRACT_SIGNATURE), today()) as days_diff
from SDM.FT_CONTRACT t1
inner join SDM.FT_CLIENT_PART_STATIC t3
on t1.ID_CUID = t3.ID_CUID
inner join (
	/*find the latest contract (active, HCVN) per client*/
    select ID_CUID,
           max(DATE_CONTRACT_SIGNATURE) as Max_Contract_Date
    from SDM.FT_CONTRACT
    where CODE_CREDIT_STATUS = 'A'
      and CODE_CREDIT_OWNER = 'HCVN'
    group by ID_CUID
) t2
on t1.ID_CUID = t2.ID_CUID
and t1.DATE_CONTRACT_SIGNATURE = t2.Max_Contract_Date

where t1.CODE_CREDIT_STATUS ='A'
and t1.CODE_CREDIT_OWNER = 'HCVN'
and (t3.CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOLERANCE = 0
or t3.CNT_DAYS_PAST_DUE_TOLERANCE is null)
and (
    (t2.Max_Contract_Date >= Today()-20 and t2.Max_Contract_Date < Today()-19)
 or (t2.Max_Contract_Date >= Today()-25 and t2.Max_Contract_Date < Today()-24)
)
;QUIT;

notes.title: Communication Policies
notes.code:
proc sql;  
create table push_policy as
select distinct ID_CUID
from SDM.FT_CLIENT_PART_DYNAMIC
where FLAG_GLOBAL_MOBILE_APP = 'Y';

create table zns_policy as
select distinct t0.ID_CUID
from SDM.FT_CLIENT_PART_STATIC t0
inner join SDM.FT_CLIENT_CONTACT t1
  on t0.SKP_CLIENT = t1.SKP_CLIENT
left join INT.CM_BLACKLIST bl
  on t0.ID_CUID = bl.ID_CUID
  and bl.BLACKLIST_CHANNEL = 'ZNS'
where t0.FLAG_PDP_CONSENT = 'Y'
and t0.FLAG_VALID_DOCUMENT = 'Y'
and t1.NAME_PHONE_MOBILE_PRIM_STATUS = 'Valid'
and bl.ID_CUID is null
;quit;

notes.title: GMA Banner Log
notes.code:
proc sql;
    create table check_log_all as
    select 
        t0.CUID,t0.CORRELATION_ID,t1.CORRELATION_ID as BN_CORRELATION_ID,
         t1.RTDM_LOG_EVENT_ID, 
        t0.CREATED_DTTM,
        t0.TEMPLATE_ID,
        t0.TEMPLATE_PRIORITY,
        t0.LIMIT_AMOUNT,
        t0.CUSTOM_FIELD_1 as CF1_CODE_PRODUCT,
        t0.CUSTOM_FIELD_2 as CF2_OFFER_TYPE,
        t0.CUSTOM_FIELD_3 as CF3_OFFER_TYPE_CODE,
        t0.CUSTOM_INFO7 as CF7_latestSegment,
        t0.CUSTOM_INFO8 as CF8_JSP,
        t0.CUSTOM_INFO9 as CF9_IDTRIGGER,
        t0.CUSTOM_INFO10 as CF10_Customer_Type,
        t0.CUSTOM_FIELD_5 as CF5_minDownPayment,
        t0.CUSTOM_INFO6,
        t0.OFFER_ID AS LOG_OFFER_ID,
	  t0.CUSTOM_FIELD_3 as LG_OFFER_TYPE_CODE,
        t1.TRIGGER_ID,
        t1.JOURNEY_START_POINT,
        t1.RESPONSE_STATUS,
        t1.RESPONSE_STATUS_DESC,
        t1.CORRELATION_ID
    from MONITOR.RTDM_LOG_GMA_MESSAGES t0
    inner join MONITOR.RTDM_LOG_GMA_BANNER t1
        on t0.rtdm_log_gma_banner_id = t1.rtdm_log_event_id
    where 1=1
      and t0.CREATED_DTTM >= dhms(today()-1, 22, 45, 0)
	and BN_CORRELATION_ID not like 'Test Case%'
    order by t0.CREATED_DTTM asc
    ;
quit;
